verdict.rationale: The axis loosely applies: INPI Portugal runs an online services portal, and a filer could reasonably ask whether it supports background automations such as auto-renewals, annuity payments or watch alerts. However, the evidence only describes manual, user-initiated procedures (filing, renewal, division, opposition, scheduling appointments). Nothing shows user-configurable automations that run autonomously, and the llms.txt probe returned 404, so there is no agent-oriented surface either.
